parameters.command: =timeout 30 docker exec wfuzz wfuzz -z file,{{ $json.wordlist }},urlencode -u "{{ $json.endpoint }}?{{ $json.param }}=FUZZ" -t 40 -f "{{ $json.wfuzzOut }}" 2>&1 | tail -3 || true

=timeout 300 docker exec schemathesis sh -c 'schemathesis run {{ $json.openApiUrl }} -u {{ $json.baseUrl }} -c all -n 3 -w 1 --report junit --report-junit-path={{ $json.schemathesisOut }} --coverage-no-report --no-color > /tmp/st.log 2>&1; echo "EXIT=$?"; tail -5 /tmp/st.log'

=timeout 300 docker exec cats sh -c 'cats -c {{ $json.openApiUrl }} -s {{ $json.baseUrl }} -k --stopAfterTimeInSec=240 -o /results/cats_report_{{ $json.runId }} --reportFormat=JUNIT > /tmp/cats.log 2>&1; echo "EXIT=$?"; tail -3 /tmp/cats.log'
